f.n: Belitung Aquatic Tourism Park - Core Zones
f.pu: To protect a site designated for activities for the protection of marine ecosystems and the organisms that live in them.
f.re: The following activities are prohibited: 1. Extractive monitoring and research; 2. All forms of fishing activities; 3. Installation of FADs; 4. All forms of marine aquaculture activities; 5. Pond activities; 6. All forms of tourism activities; 7. Construction of floating buildings; 8. Mining activities; 9. Disposal of waste and garbage.

f.pu: To ensure the protection of fish habitats and populations, tourism and recreation, and research and development.
f.re: The following activities are prohibited: 1. Fishing activities except by using fishing rods; 2. Installation of FADs; 3. Catching ornamental fish; 4. Fishing activities using boats; 5. Shrimp pond activities; 6. Tours: jet skiing, kayaking/paddling; 7. Rearing of sea turtles and giant clams for commercial purposes; 8. Mining activities; 9. Disposal of waste and garbage.

f.n: Pariaman Aquatic Park - Kasiak Is. - Core Zone
f.pu: To ensure the maintenance of turtle nesting sites in coastal areas, as well as the protection of coral reef ecosystems and economically important fish breeding areas and habitats on Kasiak Island.
f.re: The following activities are prohibited: 1. Marine tourism; 2. Land tourism; 3. Catching fish/biota; 4. Anchoring; 5. Installation of FADs; 6. Aquaculture; 7. The elimination of functions and the total area of the core zone; 8. Natural restocking.

f.n: ​​Pesisir Selatan Aquatic Park - Core Zones
f.pu: To ensure the protection of coral, protected marine biota such as turtles, giant clams and trochus, as well as the development of permitted research and education.
f.re: The following activities are prohibited: 1. Marine tourism, such as: snorkeling, diving, swimming, fishing, and boat tours; 2. Fishing/harvesting biota; 3. Anchoring; 4. Installation of FADs; 5. Aquaculture. 6. The elimination of the functions of the MPA and its utilization zones.
f.rn: Decree of the Minister of Marine Affairs and Fisheries No. 104/2021, 18 November 2021
